name: CP Range Type
citation: HL7 v2.8.2 Chapter 2C, HL7 Table 0298 - CP Range Type

entries.description: Pro-rate. Apply this price to this interval, pro-rated by whatever portion of the interval has occurred/been consumed
Flat-rate. Apply the entire price to this interval, do not pro-rate the price if the full interval has not occurred/been consumed
